items.text: Morning: Noda market festival (🧳 = where the suitcases are)
Self check-out at Hanastay Aya with the suitcases. 🧳 with us. Closed on Sun: O16 Usami-tei, O17 Yoshino Sushi, Endo Sushi.
Yotsubashi Line Tamade → Nishi-Umeda (no change), then walk to JR Osaka Station. 🧳 with us.

🧳 Coin lockers at JR Osaka Station: largest size, many take Suica. Note the locker number and take a photo. If no large locker fits the 150 cm suitcase: staffed luggage storage in the station, or Crosta Shin-Osaka (opens 9:00; then ~10 min late for the show).
JR Loop Line Osaka → Noda (2 stops), then walk to the market. 🧳 in the locker.

95th-anniversary market festival (9:00–14:00). Tuna-cutting show 9:35–10:10 on the stage by the general information desk (総合案内所): be there by ~9:20. Taiko 9:00–9:20, Awa-odori 10:15–11:00, mock auctions of produce and seafood. Breakfast and lunch at the stalls. Cash only; bring a shopping bag. 🧳 in the locker.
JR Noda → Osaka, collect the suitcases at the locker (🧳 with us again), then JR Kyoto Line Osaka → Shin-Osaka (4 min).
Shin-Osaka: ekiben and drinks; 551 Hōrai buns are sold in the station (9:00–21:30). 🧳 with us.

Backup knife shop if Sakai didn't work out: Sakai Ichimonji Mitsuhide or Jikko Uranamba, Doguyasuji, Namba (Yotsubashi Line Tamade → Namba ~10 min). Means checking out early and carrying the suitcases.
Shin-Osaka → Shinagawa → Ōtorii
Through the gate with the smartEX QR tickets; find the platform for Nozomi 416, car 14.
Nozomi 416 Shin-Osaka → Shinagawa, car 14, seats 17-D and 17-E (Fuji on the right, ~2 h in).
At Shinagawa walk to the Keikyū platforms.
Keikyū Rapid-Limited Express Shinagawa → Keikyū-Kamata (Jorudan). If missed: JR 16:57 → 17:22, ¥440.
Keikyū Airport Line Keikyū-Kamata → Ōtorii, then 9 min walk to Kc-III.
Self check-in at Kc-III (16:00–22:00 only). Quiet hours 21:00–8:00.
Evening: Kamata
Ōtorii → Keikyū-Kamata.
Nihao annex, 3 min from the east exit (17:00–22:00). Kangei is the other classic.
Back to Ōtorii and Kc-III before 21:00.
Reminders: if the suitcases were sent ahead, they are on the way to Haneda and we have overnight bags only. Confirm the TK8364 terminal (checked Sat 21, probably T2).
